rubric_items.reason: Prior F-1 resolved: the new PatientDetailPage test covers REQ-1 placement and the hasAppointments wiring. Still untested: the POST/PATCH responses that now carry visitSummary, and S-2 AC1 (Completed visits a year apart).

Assertions check exact counts, keys, href, text and DOM siblings. Weak spots: REQ-6 compares against the list endpoint over two adjacent days, and the REQ-14 page test only counts rows (2), so order is never checked.

Covers 404, zero counts, past unclosed Scheduled, future Cancelled, the local-midnight day, No-show only, and the empty page with an unclosed row. Misses the S-1 AC4 one-minute-after-now upcoming boundary.

Uses Vitest+Supertest on the API and jsdom+Testing Library on the web, in the layout's folders, with ID-prefixed names, and follows the existing DoctorDetailPage routed fetch-stub pattern. Only test files changed.
